evidence_gate.hold_reason: ≤3 core items met; missing mandatory #2 and #3. Intake is a three-item feature list, not a strategy.

P_problem_diagnosis.rationale: No causal analysis, JTBD, or behavioral data. Limitations are solution labels (reporting, one-click deploy, onboarding).

R_reframe_opportunity.rationale: No timing rationale, competitive whitespace, or user/business shift articulated.

I_intentional_bets.rationale: No explicit bet, trade-offs, non-goals, or success/failure thresholds. Three capabilities read as an unbounded roadmap.

S_systemized_execution.rationale: No OKRs, discovery loops, leading indicators, or operating rhythm for this product. Company OKR folder is still placeholder.

M_momentum_meta_reflection.rationale: Production existence for MSP Org is a momentum signal, but no retros, stopped work, or updated assumptions are recorded.

options_warning: Fewer than 3 strategic options compared; required before Approve/Conditional.

mode_0_principle_alignment.finding: Company vision/strategy folders are placeholders; Self-Service Travel is absent from prodrive-context products-in-flight. Cannot test mission coherence.

mode_2_bias_guardrails.confirmation: Intake lists capabilities already believed needed; no disconfirming search planned until sprint.
mode_2_bias_guardrails.availability: Live MSP Org deployment is salient; may over-weight that one tenant as market proof.
mode_2_bias_guardrails.sunk_cost: Production investment can push build-more without proving demand for reporting/deploy/onboarding.
mode_2_bias_guardrails.survivorship: Only MSP Org is live; failed or non-started clients are invisible without central reporting (circular).
mode_2_bias_guardrails.overconfidence: One-click deploy and full onboarding stated as limitations without effort/impact evidence.
mode_2_bias_guardrails.anchoring: Three feature headings anchor the roadmap before problem diagnosis.

top_failure_causes: Build reporting/deploy/onboarding as features with no named user changing behavior
MSP Org-only usage mistaken for multi-client product-market fit
Capacity conflict with EOS Operating Dashboard starves both
One-click deploy ships but clients stall on trust/process (wrong bottleneck)
No kill criteria; team keeps expanding scope while metrics undefined
leading_indicators: Weekly active travel requesters outside MSP Org
Median time MSP Org request planned → ended
Hours eng/ops spend per new client go-live
kill_criteria: After 2-week discovery: cannot name a person who will use central reporting weekly
After instrumented 30 days: no failed/stuck requests worth intervening on
One-click deploy pilot: second client not live within agreed SLA with <N support hours
mode_5_premortem_kill_switch.adaptation_plan: Run 1-Day Evidence Sprint; re-review only when gate = PROCEED.

mode_6_stakeholder_lens.investor_board: No thesis or unit economics; HOLD protects capital from a feature build.
mode_6_stakeholder_lens.engineering: Need problem + kill criteria before estimating reporting vs deploy vs onboarding.
mode_6_stakeholder_lens.gtm: Cannot sell multi-client Self-Service Travel without deploy/onboarding proof and a segment.
mode_6_stakeholder_lens.customer_support: Central reporting may help ops; validate ticket volume before building a console.

impact_confidence.note: No baseline failure/stuck rates or operator pain evidence.

impact_confidence.item: Near one-click deployment for other clients
impact_confidence.note: Assumes deploy friction is the binding constraint; untested.

decision_rule_applied: Required inputs missing and evidence gate ≤3 core (must include #2 and #3). Score-based Approve/Conditional/Revise not applicable until PROCEED.
